answer: Select transaction jurors by units of locked stake, not by account count. If plume, sparrow and mesa divide one deposit among three keys, their combined selection probability stays unchanged. Commit the stake before revealing the random jury seed so a farmer cannot keep generating keys until one wins. Capturing a majority now requires buying and locking a majority of eligible stake, tying up capital; key creation alone buys no votes. This still needs an unpredictable seed and a limit on whale influence.
